subject: Pilot credit request: ACME Analytics + Redbridge SI marketplace entitlement
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme-analytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Reed <michael@redbridge-si.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit request - ACME Analytics / Redbridge SI POC

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. ACME is ready to kick off a 2-week proof-of-concept (PoC) with Redbridge acting as our SI. The PoC scope: ingest ~200GB of indexed logs, run 10k queries/day across 30 concurrent sessions, and evaluate end-to-end latency and cost per inference for our observability use case.

To proceed we need a partner-sourced promotional credit or marketplace voucher that covers model inference and embedding usage for the PoC window (target start: Sep 1). Ballpark consumption is ~$6k - $9k USD. Can Redwood or Redbridge provide a partner-funded trial credit or assist with a BrightCloud marketplace voucher?

Attached is a short PoC requirements spreadsheet (PoC-requirements.xlsx). Happy to jump on a call this week to align on milestones and telemetry.

Thanks,
Alex Carter
Head of Data Platforms
Acme Analytics

Attachments: PoC-requirements.xlsx

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Michael Reed <michael@redbridge-si.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request - ACME Analytics / Redbridge SI POC

Alex — thanks for the clear scope and the sheet. Welcome — excited to get this running.

Quick next steps from our side:
- Can you confirm the requested credit amount (you mentioned $6k-$9k) so we can route approvals?
- Please sign the simple MOU for partner responsibility on data handling (I’ve attached a template to this thread).
- Michael / Redbridge: can you confirm you’ll be the billing/contact for any partner-funded voucher and submit the BrightCloud marketplace voucher request form?

Kimberly & Vivek — looping you in for approval routing and marketplace ops. If partner is able to fund the promo, we typically issue a marketplace voucher that ACME redeems; vaulting the voucher through BrightCloud procurement helps with billing continuity.

Happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff with ACME + Redbridge + Redwood ops this week. Proposed times: Wed 8/26 10am PT or Thu 8/27 9am PT.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MOU-template.docx (placeholder)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request - ACME Analytics / Redbridge SI POC

Jasmine / Kim — I reviewed ACME's ask and the PoC sheet. I approve up to $7,500 in partner-funded promotional credit for this pilot, conditional on:
1) Signed MOU between ACME and Redbridge confirming scope and responsibilities;
2) Redbridge submits the BrightCloud marketplace voucher request form and indicates the funding source;
3) Voucher redemption window limited to 30 days from activation and usage telemetry shared weekly.

Ben / Laura — please hold back any additional discretionary credits until we see the signed MOU and the marketplace voucher request. Once procurement confirms issuance we can finalize activation.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval-note.pdf

From: BrightCloud Procurement <procurement@brightcloud.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace voucher issuance request - ACME / Redbridge

Hi Kimberly / Jasmine,

Thanks for the request. We can issue a marketplace voucher tied to Redbridge's marketplace reseller account once we receive a completed voucher-request form and marketplace onboarding confirmation.

Please submit the attached Marketplace Voucher Request Form (marketplace-voucher-request-form.pdf) completed by Redbridge and include: reseller account ID, funding amount, and desired activation window. Once the form is approved the voucher code will be issued within 24-48 hours.

Note: vouchers issued through BrightCloud have a 30-day redemption window by default; if you require a different window include a justification on the form.

Best,
Procurement Team
BrightCloud Marketplace

Attachment: marketplace-voucher-request-form.pdf

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme-analytics.com>, Michael Reed <michael@redbridge-si.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request - ACME Analytics / Redbridge SI POC

Alex / Michael — quick update:

- Vivek has provisionally approved up to $7,500 in partner-funded promo credit (see approval note).
- Michael / Redbridge, please complete and return the BrightCloud marketplace-voucher-request-form (attached by BrightCloud procurement) and upload the signed MOU (signed-mou-acme-redbridge.pdf).
- BrightCloud will then issue a voucher code with a 30-day redemption window; we will apply the voucher to ACME's trial project and monitor usage.

We’ll schedule the kickoff for Thu 8/27 9am PT as proposed — invite sent. Action items:
- Michael: return voucher form + signed MOU by EOD 8/27.
- Alex: confirm you’re comfortable with $7.5k ceiling; if you expect higher consumption indicate a preferred contingency.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting ACME running.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: marketplace-voucher-request-form.pdf, signed-mou-acme-redbridge.pdf
